tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Reported by KETV: Attorneys General from Nebraska, Iowa sue OpenAI over chatbot.
Reported by Central Oregon Daily: Anthropic revenue jumps to $16.8 billion in third quarter, FT reports.
Reported by Arizona Capitol Times: Arizona, other states sue OpenAI alleging harms to the public.
Reported by KBOI: Idaho AG files suit alleging OpenAI misled parents about ChatGPT's safety for kids.
Reported by CBS News: OpenAI sued by 8 states over claims ChatGPT coached kids to harm themselves.
Free every hour.
